item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence that Tshisekedi built a durable system to let peaceful protest, dissent, or community organizing proceed without retaliation, surveillance, or selective punishment. The positive material is mostly conflict-mediation and ceasefire diplomacy, while the civic-space record is dominated by arrests, intimidation, and protest suppression.","evidence":[{"title":"DR Congo’s arrest of activists invokes déjà vu of growing repression","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/dr-congos-arrest-of-activists-invokes-deja-vu-of-growing-repression/","summary":"Security services cracked down on LUCHA activists and other peaceful protesters, using abduction-like arrests, unknown detention, and forced statements; Amnesty says the state-of-siege context enabled suppression of criticism.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.6","3B.7"]},{"title":"DRC: Authorities must immediately free detained journalist","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/drc-authorities-must-immediately-free-detained-journalist/","summary":"Stanis Bujakera’s continued detention was described as judicial harassment meant to chill journalists and other free voices, showing a retaliatory approach to dissent.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.6"]},{"title":"Congo police break up small protest over parliamentary election results","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-16","url":"https://www.kelo.com/2024/01/16/congo-police-break-up-small-protest-over-parliamentary-election-results/","summary":"Police dispersed a Kinshasa protest over election results, beating some participants and arresting others, which is direct evidence against a permissive stance toward peaceful assembly.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.6","3B.4"]},{"title":"DRC President Felix Tshisekedi must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty said the state of siege militarized everyday life, concentrated power in military and police officials, and coincided with a crackdown on dissent under the pretext of defending the country against enemies.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.6","3B.5","3B.4"]},{"title":"World Report 2025: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2025","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW says authorities cracked down on opposition members, activists, critics, and journalists throughout 2024; police used excessive force to break up demonstrations, and opposition leaders were targeted and arrested.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.6","3B.7"]},{"title":"Protesters in Congo call for the release of political prisoners, including 3 top opposition figures","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-09-25","url":"https://halifax.citynews.ca/2024/09/25/protesters-in-congo-call-for-the-release-of-political-prisoners-including-3-top-opposition-figures/","summary":"Hundreds protested in Kinshasa over political prisoners, and opposition figures accused Tshisekedi of trying to muzzle opponents and silence dissenting voices. This shows protest activity existed, but the need for such a protest underscores repression rather than protection.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.6"]},{"title":"Les Téké et les Yaka s’engagent à mettre fin aux hostilités dans l’ouest de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-04-06","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/les_teke_et_les_yaka_sengagent_a_mettre_fin_aux_hostilites_dans_louest_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi presided over a local peace agreement in western DRC that relied on dialogue, mediation, and arbitration; this is limited positive evidence for community organization resolving conflict without retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la RDC: les présidents Félix Tshisekedi et João Lourenço appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au-respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly backed the Luanda ceasefire and next-step talks; this is positive for de-escalation, but it is only indirect evidence for civic-space protection.","question_ids":["3B.8","2B.7","2B.10"]}]}
